intro: Follow how a text links its ideas and how some words pick up what has already been said.
p.huerto.consejo: The h is silent: WER-to. It is masculine. A «jardín» is for flowers.
p.solar.consejo: It is also an adjective: «energía solar». Here it is a masculine noun: «el solar».
p.vecinos.consejo: The v sounds b and the c sounds th: be-THI-nos. For a woman, «vecina».
p.iniciativa.consejo: It is feminine: «una iniciativa». The stress is on «TI»: i-ni-thya-TI-ba.
p.herramientas.consejo: It is feminine: «la herramienta». The h is silent: e-rra-MYEN-ta.
p.mantenimiento.consejo: It comes from «mantener». It is a long word: man-te-ni-MYEN-to.
p.participación.consejo: It ends in -ción and is feminine. The stress is on «ción»: par-ti-thi-pa-THYON.
p.por ello.consejo: It is like «por eso», but more formal. It sums up what came before and gives a result.
p.mientras tanto.consejo: It links two moments: while one thing happens, another occurs. It usually takes a comma.
p.quienes.consejo: It is the plural of «quien»: «quienes cuidan el huerto». No accent, because it does not ask.
p.esa iniciativa.consejo: «Esa» points to something already said and avoids repetition: «una iniciativa» → «esa iniciativa».
p.a pesar de.consejo: It marks a difficulty that stops nothing: «a pesar de la lluvia».
b1.titulo: Follow the two threads of the text
b1.texto:
To understand a text, follow two threads.

- **Connectors** show how ideas relate: **por ello** gives a result, **a pesar de** points to a difficulty, **mientras tanto** links two moments, **aun así** contrasts.
- **References** pick up something already said: **esa iniciativa**, **quienes lo cuidan**, **allí**, **lo**.

Before you read a sentence, ask: how does it connect to the one before? What does that word refer to?
b2.f0.texto: There is a new garden on the empty plot in my street.
b2.f2.texto: The neighbours of the district look after it.
b2.f3.texto: That initiative began with six families.
b2.f4.texto: That is why there are so many people there on Saturdays.
b2.f5.texto: In spite of the little space, they plant tomatoes and flowers.
b2.f6.texto: In the meantime, they are waiting for a water tap.
b2.f7.texto: Those who look after the garden organise upkeep shifts.
b3.titulo: Words from the garden and the text
b4.texto:
An idea reappears with other words. That way it is not repeated:

- **Noun + «este / ese»:** un huerto → **ese huerto**, **esa iniciativa**, **esa petición**.
- **Pronoun:** el huerto → **lo** cuidan; los vecinos → **ellos**, **quienes**.
- **Adverb:** en el huerto → **allí**.

And connectors announce the relation: **por ello** (result), **a pesar de** (difficulty), **mientras tanto** (at the same time), **aun así** (contrast).
b4.e0.texto: That initiative was born on an empty plot.
b4.e1.texto: The neighbours look after the garden and water it every afternoon.
b4.e2.texto: For that reason, the group asked for a water tap.
b5.f0.texto: A year ago, the empty plot on the corner was a field of dust, stones and rusty cans.
b5.f1.texto: Several neighbours cleared the ground with old spades and filled it with black soil.
b5.f2.texto: The initiative began with six families and now brings together two schools of the district.
b5.f3.texto: Although the space is small, those who look after it have planted herbs, tomatoes and flowers.
b5.f4.texto: For that reason, the group has asked the association for a water tap and a cupboard to keep tools in.
b5.f5.texto: That request is still waiting for an answer, like a seed under the earth.
b5.f6.texto: In the meantime, the participants bring water from their homes in bottles and buckets.
b5.f7.texto: In the afternoons, the air of the garden smells of mint, damp earth and freshly cut tomato.
b5.f8.texto: One of the schools organises science workshops among the furrows and takes its pupils there every month.
b5.f9.texto: Even so, the neighbours believe that this initiative is worthwhile because of the participation it generates.
b6.o0: a la toma de agua y al armario
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It picks up what the group asked for earlier.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The workshops are organised; nobody has asked for them.
b6.o2: a los tomates y las flores
b6.o2.refuerzo: That is planted; it is not requested.
b7.frase: El grupo necesita agua. ____ ha pedido una toma.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it! It gives the result of the need.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «A pesar de» marks a difficulty and needs a noun.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Mientras tanto» links two simultaneous things; here there is a consequence.
b7.pregunta: The second sentence is the result. What is missing?
b8.frase: Por ello el grupo pide una toma de agua
b8.traduccion: For that reason, the group asks for a water tap
b9.o0.refuerzo: A result is marked with «por ello» or «por eso».
b9.o1.refuerzo: Yes! There is an obstacle, but it is done anyway.
b9.o2.refuerzo: A good cause is marked with «gracias a».
b9.pregunta: What relation does «a pesar de» mark?
b10.frase: Cuidan el huerto y ____ riegan cada tarde.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Le» is for people (to him, to her), not for the object.
b10.o2.refuerzo: Well done! «Lo» picks up «el huerto», masculine singular.
b10.pregunta: Which word picks up «el huerto» without repeating it?
b12.o0.refuerzo: The tomatoes are looked after; they look after nothing.
b12.o1.refuerzo: The tools are used; they do not look after anything.
b12.o2.refuerzo: That is it! «Quienes» names the people without repeating the noun.
b12.pregunta: «Quienes cuidan el huerto». Who are they?
p.cuida.consejo: Present of «cuidar», for «él» or «ella». Here it asks who takes care of it.
p.cuidan.consejo: Plural of «cuida». Here it means the people who take care of it.
p.empezó.consejo: Past tense of «empezar», for «él» or «ella». The «z» sounds like «th».
p.espacio.consejo: Space or room. The «c» before «i» sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.plantan.consejo: Plural of «planta». It means putting plants into the ground.
p.organizan.consejo: Plural of «organiza». The «z» sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.vacío.consejo: The «c» before «i» sounds like «th». Stress on «THI».
p.riegan.consejo: Plural of «riega», from «regar». The «e» becomes «ie» in the stressed form.
p.oxidadas.consejo: Feminine plural of «oxidado». The «x» sounds like «ks».
p.limpiaron.consejo: Past tense of «limpiar», for «ellos». The «p» is clear.
p.terreno.consejo: A piece of land. The «rr» between vowels is strong.
p.palas.consejo: Tools for digging the earth. Stress on «PA».
p.llenaron.consejo: Past tense of «llenar», for «ellos». The «ll» sounds like «y».
p.escuelas.consejo: Plural of «escuela». The «c» before «u» sounds like «k».
p.plantado.consejo: Participle of «plantar». «Han plantado» means they have planted.
p.petición.consejo: A formal request, often written. The «c» sounds like «th».
p.participantes.consejo: People who take part. The «c» before «i» sounds like «th».
p.cubos.consejo: Plural of «cubo». The «c» before «u» sounds like «k».
p.menta.consejo: A fragrant herb with fresh leaves. Stress on «MEN».
p.organiza.consejo: Present of «organizar», for «él» or «ella». The «z» sounds like «th».
p.ciencias.consejo: Plural of «ciencia». Both «c» and «z» sound like «th» in Spain.
p.surcos.consejo: Lines dug in the soil to plant seeds. The «c» sounds like «k».
p.creen.consejo: Plural of «cree», from «creer». Stress falls on «KREN».
p.genera.consejo: Present of «generar», for «él» or «ella». The «g» before «e» sounds like «h».
